questions.prompt: Does quietness establish social anxiety disorder?
questions.answer: No; individual diagnosis requires qualified assessment.

questions.prompt: What is an appropriate response to an access barrier?
questions.answer: Seek an authorised accommodation or suitable alternative.
questions.feedback: Do not treat it as lack of motivation.

questions.prompt: When may qualified care be appropriate?
questions.answer: When wanted or when persistent difficulties interfere with functioning.

questions.prompt: What takes priority in immediate danger?

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only; use answer-specific feedback.
scoring.practice: Distinguishes preference, access, skill and clinical support needs; selects appropriate, consent-based routes.
scoring.transfer: Complete a fictional low-stakes practice plan with separate perceived-capability and skill evidence, voluntary task variants, specific feedback and a support decision. Include access, refusal and a contrasting clinical or emergency route; explain the limits of the evidence.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
